control_failures.control_label: setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices
controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems
dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy

facts.title: unplanned release of pressure energy at PSV-7103

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.
Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices on PSV-7103 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in inspecting pressure equipment, specifically performing in-service and hydrostatic inspection. PSV-7103 (tank relief and vent devices) is in service for tank overpressure and vacuum protection. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was in place but did not perform. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 1 November 2012 a hazard report was recorded on PSV-7103 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during start-up after maintenance; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
